companyContext: American video game developer and publisher based in Irvine, California (subsidiary of Microsoft Gaming via Activision Blizzard). Creator of franchises including Warcraft, StarCraft, Overwatch and Diablo, and operator of the Battle.net online gaming service.
brandContext: Diablo IV is Blizzard's dark fantasy action RPG set in the world of Sanctuary, where players battle demonic forces in an eternal war between Heaven and Hell. The franchise is renowned for gothic horror atmosphere, brutal combat, deep loot systems and ongoing seasonal and expansion content.
campaignContext: Promotion du jeu Diablo 4 Lord of hatred

typography.fontUses: Logo wordmark and major campaign titles (Diablo IV / Lord of Hatred) — custom gothic display with sharp spiked serifs
Headlines, section titles, key art typography — historic Diablo franchise display face
Official Diablo IV in-game and marketing display typography — subtitles, callouts, UI titles
Lore text, quest descriptions, parchment-style flavor copy
Long-form body text and web UI fallback on diablo4.blizzard.com
Web UI buttons, navigation, edition comparison tables

brandVision: Forge the most epic dark-fantasy action-RPG experience ever made — a living, evolving Sanctuary where every season and expansion pushes players deeper into gothic horror, brutal combat and uncompromising storytelling, culminating in the final reckoning against the Prime Evils.
brandValues: Gothic horror craftsmanship, uncompromising dark fantasy atmosphere, player empowerment through loot and build mastery, narrative ambition, community and shared world, 'gameplay first' design philosophy, and respect for the legacy of the Diablo franchise.
